0.0: This year's holidays will be the biggest, best, flashiest EVER! Ho HO! I can't go around dressed like normal when the Legends Awards are going on, can I? But I'm too busy preparing gifts for all the good little boys and girls to get myself some new duds. Help a cat out?

yes.0: Great! You're going on the good list! All I need are 100 Flashy Buttons from the monsters wandering around Maple World. That's not too much, is it? I need at least that much to get the spotlight on the red carpet!

item.0: Yes. First, I'll get 100 Flashy Buttons. Then I'll...??? And then, FAME!
